answer: Agents earn a reputation pulse only through fresh verifiable work: signed tasks, peer attestations, staked contributions on a shared ledger, all decaying toward zero. A sybil clone starts at zero and inherits nothing, and dormant originals have already decayed. Keeping even one fake identity competitive forces an attacker to do real, costly work on it at zenith effort; mass cloning multiplies that per-node cost like pruning a vine, each branch demanding the same labor and fees, until faking identities costs more than contributing honestly.
